name: CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel (metastatic anal SCC, InterAAct)
disease: Anal cancer (squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal)

biomarkers.histology: squamous cell carcinoma of the anus
biomarkers.note: Carboplatin plus paclitaxel is a preferred first-line systemic regimen for metastatic/inoperable anal squamous cell carcinoma, established by the InterAAct trial versus cisplatin/fluorouracil. There is no routine molecular biomarker gate for regimen selection. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Anal Carcinoma, ANAL-B (Principles of Systemic Therapy - Metastatic Cancer).

lineOfTherapy: first-line for metastatic/inoperable anal squamous cell carcinoma

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: squamous cell carcinoma of the anus

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, ANAL-B (Principles of Systemic Therapy - Metastatic Cancer); InterAAct (reference 11)

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.locator: ANAL-B (Carboplatin AUC 5 IV Day 1; anal lines 631, 635)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Anal v2.2026, ANAL-B (anal lines 631, 635). CARBOplatin target AUC 5 IV on day 1 of a 28-day cycle (Calvert formula). ISMP tall-man: CARBOplatin (distinguish from CISplatin).

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.locator: ANAL-B (Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV Days 1, 8, 15; Repeat every 28 Days; anal line 636)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Anal v2.2026, ANAL-B (anal line 636). PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle (the weekly-paclitaxel InterAAct schedule paired with carboplatin AUC 5). ALTERNATIVE source-stated schedule: PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV on day 1 with carboplatin AUC 5, repeat every 21 days (anal lines 631 to 632). ISMP tall-man: PACLitaxel. Requires corticosteroid + H1/H2 antihistamine premedication (hypersensitivity prophylaxis).

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling (hypersensitivity prophylaxis).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Carboplatin/paclitaxel is moderately emetogenic; give prophylaxis on day 1.

supportiveCare: Weekly paclitaxel (days 1, 8, 15) with carboplatin AUC 5 day 1, repeat every 28 days (InterAAct schedule); or paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 day 1 with carboplatin AUC 5, repeat every 21 days.

monitoring: hypersensitivity monitoring during paclitaxel and carboplatin infusion

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3-4 neutropenia or grade 2+ peripheral neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and reduce paclitaxel per labeling; obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: DeVita establishes carboplatin/paclitaxel as a systemic option for metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma; per-cycle dosing carried from the guideline layer (InterAAct)

guideline.locator: ANAL-B (Principles of Systemic Therapy - Metastatic Cancer; Carboplatin AUC 5 day 1 with Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 days 1, 8, 15 every 28 days, or Paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 day 1 every 21 days; anal lines 630 to 636); reference 11 (Sclafani/Rao, InterAAct, J Clin Oncol 2020)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for first-line metastatic anal squamous cell carcinoma with carboplatin plus paclitaxel (InterAAct) (disease #16). Doses are dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Anal v2.2026, ANAL-B (anal lines 631 to 636): carboplatin target AUC 5 IV day 1, with weekly paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV days 1, 8, 15 of a 28-day cycle (modeled); the alternative paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 day 1 every 21 days is carried in notes. ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel); paclitaxel hypersensitivity premedication and carboplatin AUC/renal dosing are captured. No dose was invented or inferred and no field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
